title: TreeAgent: Structure-Aware Memory Agent for Processing Long Hierarchical Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.13946v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Practical Web applications increasingly require agents to interpret long conversations or documents. For inputs exceeding the context windows of large language models (LLMs), memory agents process segments sequentially and retain past information in bounded memory. However, they typically divide inputs into flat token segments without preserving structure or hierarchy, causing three limitations for structured data such as API responses or HTML documents. First, fixed-length segmentation can split fields of the same record, breaking their relationships. Second, segments lack hierarchical information, obscuring their structural context and positions. Third, successive memory updates may discard details of earlier sibling records needed for reasoning on later segments. To address these limitations, we propose TreeAgent, a structure-aware agent that uses the input hierarchy to guide both segment-wise context processing and access to past inf

translated_title: TreeAgent：面向长层级数据处理的结构感知记忆智能体
translated_abstract: 实际的Web应用日益需要智能体来理解长对话或长文档。对于超出大语言模型（LLM）上下文窗口的输入，记忆智能体会按顺序处理分段，并在有限的内存中保留过去的信息。然而，这些方法通常将输入划分为扁平的token分段，而不保留结构或层级，这对API响应或HTML文档等结构化数据造成了三个限制。第一，固定长度的分段可能拆分同一记录的字段，破坏它们之间的关系。第二，分段缺乏层级信息，掩盖了其结构上下文和位置。第三，连续的内存更新可能丢弃较早的兄弟记录的细节，而这些细节是后续分段推理所需的。为解决这些限制，我们提出了TreeAgent，一个结构感知的智能体，它利用输入的层级结构来指导分段上下文处理和对过去信息的访问。
tldr: TreeAgent提出了一种结构感知的记忆智能体，利用输入数据的层级结构来指导分段处理与历史信息访问，解决了现有记忆智能体在处理API响应、HTML文档等长层级结构化数据时拆分记录字段、丢失层级信息和兄弟记录细节的问题。
en_tdlr: TreeAgent is a structure-aware memory agent that leverages the input hierarchy to guide segment-wise context processing and access to past information, overcoming flat segmentation limitations when handling long structured data such as API responses and HTML documents.
